name: Bubble
tagline: No-code platform for building custom web apps with workflows and data

pricing.notes: Official pricing URL checked; 2026 public references list Starter around $32/month monthly and $29/month annually.

tiers.name: Free, Web & Mobile
tiers.limits: 1 editor; 50,000 workload units/month; 6 hours server logs; development version only
tiers.notes: No live web or app-store deployment.

tiers.name: Starter, Web & Mobile
tiers.limits: 1 editor; 175,000 workload units/month; 2 days logs; 5 mobile build submissions/month; 3 live app versions
tiers.notes: Official page exposed $59/month equivalent when billed annually; monthly price was not reliably exposed.

tiers.name: Growth, Web & Mobile
tiers.limits: 2 editors; 250,000 workload units/month; 14 days logs; 10 branches; 10 build submissions; 5 live versions

tiers.name: Team, Web & Mobile
tiers.limits: 5 editors; 500,000 workload units/month; 20 days logs; 25 branches; 20 build submissions; 8 live versions

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.limits: Custom workload, hosting region, server, build and support limits

pricing.freeTierCaps: 1 editor; 50,000 workload units/month; 6 hours of server logs; development-only web/mobile versions with no live deployment
pricing.billingTerms: monthly + annual (save up to 20%); each project needs its own plan
pricing.hiddenCosts: Workload units are the real meter and web + mobile share one allowance; overage or prepaid workload tiers cost extra, storage is $3 per additional 100 GB/month, and paid plugin subscriptions are separate

verdictSummary: A specific Bubble app is often vibecodable now; rebuilding Bubble's editor, workflow engine, plugin ecosystem, hosting, and scaling layer is not.
coreLoopDIY: Rebuild the target app directly in code with CRUD, auth, workflows, and hosting rather than cloning Bubble as a platform.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because future changes can be made visually without owning a codebase.

priorArt.name: Appsmith
priorArt.desc: Open-source low-code builder for internal tools; partial prior art for visual app building

alternatives.name: Budibase
alternatives.desc: Custom web apps with data, forms, screens, and automations; design freedom is far below Bubble's.

facts.install: Docker image or Docker Compose; Kubernetes is also supported
facts.engines: Model-agnostic; the agent builder supports bring-your-own AI provider credentials
facts.dataFormat: Built-in app data and app definitions are stored in CouchDB, files in MinIO/S3-compatible object storage, and connected external data remains in its source system
facts.gapVsPaid: Budibase's component and layout system is optimized for internal business screens and is far less flexible for polished public consumer interfaces than Bubble.
facts.setupBlocker: Requires Docker and persistent storage; production use also means owning upgrades, TLS, backups, and database/network access

alternatives.name: Corteza
alternatives.desc: A self-hosted business-app suite with records, pages, workflows, charts, and enterprise-grade amounts of configuration.

facts.install: Docker Compose with a configured MySQL or PostgreSQL database
facts.dataFormat: Records and configuration live in the configured SQL database; uploaded attachments live in the server persistence directory
facts.gapVsPaid: Corteza is a record-and-workflow suite, not a pixel-flexible public web-app designer, so a consumer-facing Bubble product will look and behave much more constrained.
facts.setupBlocker: Docker, a database, secrets, persistent-volume permissions, and a reverse proxy/TLS are the first operational hurdle

alternatives.name: Joget Community Edition
alternatives.desc: Forms, lists, workflows, and role-aware apps from a product old enough to have survived several no-code fashions.

facts.install: Download the Community Edition bundle or deploy its Docker image/on-premises package
facts.dataFormat: Application definitions, workflow state, and records live in the configured relational database; uploaded files live on the Joget server
facts.gapVsPaid: Joget excels at forms and workflows but cannot approach Bubble's freedom for bespoke public-facing layouts, interactions, and responsive design.
facts.setupBlocker: The first real hurdle is administering a Java web stack and database rather than clicking through a managed signup

alternatives.name: NocoBase
alternatives.desc: A full database-backed web-app builder with pages, roles, actions, workflows, and plugins; more business app than consumer startup.

facts.install: NocoBase CLI or Docker deployment with MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL
facts.engines: Built-in AI employees can connect to common LLMs; exact provider support depends on installed AI plugins
facts.dataFormat: Business data lives in standard relational tables in the configured MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL database; files use configured local or object storage
facts.gapVsPaid: NocoBase is fundamentally a database-backed administrative app builder, so it gives up Bubble's consumer-app design freedom and front-end plugin ecosystem.
facts.setupBlocker: Requires a database, secrets, and deployment administration; the community license also preserves NocoBase branding and restricts some uses

alternatives.name: REI3
alternatives.desc: A sober business-app builder with forms, reports, roles, workflows, and no per-user meter.

facts.install: Native Linux/Windows server package or Docker Compose, connected to PostgreSQL
facts.dataFormat: Human-readable application records and configuration live in a PostgreSQL database controlled by the operator
facts.gapVsPaid: REI3's utilitarian forms, reports, and pages are a poor substitute for Bubble's highly customized public front ends and interaction design.
facts.setupBlocker: You must provision PostgreSQL and configure a server/reverse proxy; it is not a managed one-click workspace

rejectedAlternatives.name: Bubble Free
rejectedAlternatives.desc: A development sandbox with no live production site; the core job begins when you pay.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Saltcorn
rejectedAlternatives.desc: It does the job, but its own security page lists fresh critical RCE, SQL injection, path-traversal, and cross-tenant bugs.

notes: One of the site's most important explanatory pages: build the app, not the platform.
prompt:
Build me the app I currently run on Bubble, as plain code I own. Requirements:

- First ask me for: the 3-5 core screens, the data types with their fields,
  and the single workflow that matters most. Rebuild that app, not Bubble.
- Stack: Node + Express + better-sqlite3, server-rendered EJS templates plus
  htmx for interactivity. No SPA framework, no build step.
- CRUD for each data type: list page with search and filters, detail page,
  create and edit forms with validation.
- Workflows become plain functions: a form submit updates rows, sends email
  via Resend (key in .env), redirects. Scheduled workflows become node-cron
  jobs in the same process.
- Auth only if people other than me log in: email+password sessions with
  bcrypt and a session cookie, no roles unless I named them. If it is just
  me, skip auth and bind to localhost.
- File uploads go to uploads/, images resized with sharp.
- One SQLite file plus a nightly CSV dump of every table, data never trapped.
- Out of scope: a visual editor, a plugin system, anything platform-shaped.
  The deliverable is one app that deploys with node server.js on a $5 VPS.
- README: deploy steps and how to add a field later, the code is the editor
  now.
